title: FLA import: bitmap placements reference unknown media IDs (12-15) — stage objects silently dropped
description:
## Root Cause

Before commit b3eb5e6 (MFC CArchive class-reference indexing fix, task 0889), CPicSwf entries in Magnet.fla were being misidentified as CPicBitmapRef due to class-tag confusion. Combined with missing CMediaSound detection (task 0887), media IDs 12–15 (which are bitmap streams in Magnet.fla) had no corresponding library items, causing:

  [FLA import] bitmap placement references unknown media #12; skipping
  (similarly for #13, #14, #15)

## What Was Fixed (by other agents, gates/preconditions for this task)

1. **Task 0889 (b3eb5e6)**: Fixed MFC CArchive class-reference indexing — CPicSwf entries no longer misidentified as CPicBitmapRef.
2. **Task 0887 (691cdc5)**: Added CMediaSound detection in parseFla8Contents — sounds stored via CMediaSound objects in the Contents stream (like Magnet.fla's sounds at media IDs 16–21, 32) are now registered before media-stream decoding, so the bitmap decoder only runs against non-sound Media N streams (including 12–15 which contain Flash lossless bitmap data).

## What This Task Added

Task 0894 verified the fix and added regression tests:

1. **** — new test asserting:
   - No 'bitmap placement references unknown media' warnings when loading Magnet.fla
   - Bitmap library items for media IDs 12–15 are present in the imported document

2. **** — fixed absolute path to use  pattern consistent with the rest of the test suite; removed unused  import.

## Evidence

All 306 test files pass (4788 tests):
  pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run
  Test Files  306 passed (306)
  Tests  4788 passed | 5 todo (4793)

The bitmap-debug.test.ts passes, confirming:
- No unresolved bitmap media placements
- Bitmap 12, 13, 14, 15 all present in Magnet.fla import
